quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #16
										  					
  

37 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: About ____ of all traffic deaths involve alcohol.
questions.explanation: Drinking and driving is illegal and dangerous. About 38 percent of all traffic deaths involve alcohol.

questions.question: What is the correct order of colors on a traffic light from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is always at the top and green at the bottom. On a horizontal traffic light, red is always on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What should you do when you encounter an aggressive driver?

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Make sure they know you disapprove.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: If another driver is threatening you or driving dangerously, stay calm and create distance. Slow down and let them pass. Do not make eye contact or make rude gestures.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns about a steep downhill slope. Adjust your speed to prevent brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: How can you avoid needing to make emergency stops while driving in traffic?

options.text: Honk your horn to alert other drivers.
Look ahead and keep a safe distance from other cars.
Drive in the right lane only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look ahead and keep a safe distance from other cars.
questions.explanation: A safe following distance lets you react to problems without sudden braking, which could cause a driver behind you to crash into your car.

questions.question:
If you get seven points on your driver license, which of the following can happen?
    I. You must file proof of financial responsibility.
    II. You can have three points removed if you complete a driver improvement clinic.
questions.explanation: With seven points on your license, you may be assigned to a driver improvement clinic, which costs $65. If you complete it successfully, three points are removed from your record.

questions.question: What does a green downward arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green downward arrow means you can use that lane.

questions.question: When driving in an area where children are playing, what should you expect?

options.text: They know when it is safe to cross.
They will stop at the curb before crossing.
They may run in front of you without looking.
They will not cross unless an adult is with them.

questions.correctAnswerText: They may run in front of you without looking.
questions.explanation: Always slow down and be extra careful when children are nearby. They may not understand danger and can run in front of you without warning.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and check for pedestrians and traffic. Wait for the intersection to clear before driving.

questions.question: What color are the pavement markings that separate traffic moving in opposite directions?
questions.explanation: Yellow lines are used in the center of the road to separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: What happens to a bicyclist who does not obey traffic laws?

options.text: Bicyclists do not have to obey traffic laws.
Will always get a warning from police.
Will have their bicycle taken away.

questions.explanation: Bicyclists have the same rights and duties as drivers. Both bicyclists and drivers who break traffic laws can receive a ticket.

questions.question: What should you do if traffic signals are not working due to a power outage?

options.text: Park off the road and wait for power to return.
Use hand signals to tell other drivers what you plan to do.
Turn on hazard lights and go through without stopping.
Treat it like a four-way stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a four-way stop.
questions.explanation: When a traffic light is not working, treat the intersection like a four-way stop. Yield to other drivers, and when it is your turn, go through slowly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: How can stress affect your driving?

options.text: It lowers your ability to focus on driving.
It decreases your chances of an accident.
It causes you to fall asleep at the wheel.
It makes you more aware of others around you.

questions.correctAnswerText: It lowers your ability to focus on driving.
questions.explanation: Stress and strong emotions hurt your ability to drive well. When you are worried, angry, or upset, you cannot concentrate on driving. It is better to wait until you feel calm before driving.

questions.question: How many points on your license within three years will result in suspension if your license has never been suspended before?
questions.explanation: Accumulating 12 points within three years results in license suspension. If your license was previously suspended, it will be suspended again after just 8 points.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When driving slowly disrupts the normal flow of traffic
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone
Only when driving in rural areas
When driving under bad weather conditions

questions.correctAnswerText: When driving slowly disrupts the normal flow of traffic
questions.explanation: Driving too slowly and disrupting traffic flow is illegal. You can receive a ticket for driving too slowly.

questions.question: Your vehicle hits a parked car and you cannot find the owner. What should you do?

options.text: You have done all you need to do.
You must wait for police to arrive.
You must leave a written note with your name, address, and details of what happened.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must leave a written note with your name, address, and details of what happened.
questions.explanation: Stop and try to find the owner of the parked car. If you cannot find them, leave a written note with your name, address, and what happened.

questions.question: When may you park or stop on the shoulder of a freeway?

options.text: As long as you turn on your hazard lights.
If no part of your vehicle is on the road.
If you need to check a map for directions.
Only if you have an emergency.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only if you have an emergency.
questions.explanation: You cannot park on a freeway shoulder except during an emergency.

questions.question: What must you do when you see a red traffic light?
questions.explanation: A red light means you must stop before entering the intersection. You must stop at the stop line and before entering any crosswalk.

questions.question: When adjusting your inside mirror, what should you be able to see clearly?
questions.explanation: Adjust the inside mirror so you can see the entire rear window. You should only need to move your eyes, not your head, when using this mirror.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road surface is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What colors are highway exit distance signs?
questions.explanation: Direction and destination signs are green with white letters or symbols.

questions.question: Why is night driving more difficult than day driving?

options.text: Cars overheat more quickly at night.
Visibility is reduced in the dark.
It rains more often at night.
You encounter more motorcycles at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Visibility is reduced in the dark.
questions.explanation: At night, you cannot see as far ahead. Always use your headlights and drive slowly enough to stop within the distance you can see.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Drive carefully where pedestrians may be present.

questions.question: What does an orange sign indicate?

options.text: The start of a no passing zone.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction, maintenance, or emergency work ahead.

questions.question: When should you slow down for a curve in the road?

options.text: In the middle of the curve.
Only if you see approaching traffic.

questions.explanation: Slow down before you enter a curve. Speeding through a curve can cause your tires to lose grip on the road.

questions.question: What can a leaking exhaust system cause?

options.text: Your vehicle to need a tune-up sooner than normal.
You to become drowsy while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: You to become drowsy while driving.
questions.explanation: A leaking exhaust system can release toxic fumes into your vehicle. These fumes can make you drowsy and can be very dangerous. In extreme cases, they can cause serious harm or death.

questions.question: You are in an accident and another person is injured. What should you do?

options.text: Move the injured person away from the scene immediately.
Always leave the injured person where they are.
Do not move the injured person unless necessary. Keep them warm and give first aid if you can.
Stay away from the injured person.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not move the injured person unless necessary. Keep them warm and give first aid if you can.
questions.explanation: Do not move an injured person unnecessarily. Moving them wrong can turn minor injuries into serious ones. Keep them warm until help arrives. If there is heavy bleeding, apply direct pressure to stop the flow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for other traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. You should slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and keep more distance between your car and the car ahead.

questions.question: Before passing another vehicle, when should you signal?

options.text: Early enough so other drivers know what you plan to do.

questions.correctAnswerText: Early enough so other drivers know what you plan to do.
questions.explanation: Signal early before you pass so other drivers have time to know your plans.

questions.question: When turning left, you must give the right-of-way to:

options.text: Other drivers already in the intersection.

questions.explanation: When turning left, you must give the right-of-way to oncoming traffic, pedestrians, bicycles, and other drivers already in the intersection.

questions.question: When you leave your vehicle unattended, you must:

options.text: Lock the ignition and remove the key.

questions.explanation: When leaving your vehicle, you must turn off the engine, lock the ignition, remove the key, and set the parking brake.

questions.question: Which of these violations has the most points?

options.text: Driving on the wrong side of the road

questions.explanation: Passing a stopped school bus is 5 points. Reckless driving, wrong side of road, and illegal passing are each 4 points.

questions.question: What does a double solid yellow line in the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers cannot pass.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Solid lines mean drivers cannot pass.
